source(output(
		BatchId as integer,
		AnticipatedDowngradeDate as date,
		DowngradeFallOutReason as string,
		SubscriberId as string,
		SubscriberName as string,
		GroupId as string,
		ClassId as string,
		EX19DTE as date,
		PremDueDte as date,
		PremDue as string,
		CovType as string,
		BatchDate as date,
		RunDate as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT * FROM DOWNGRADEFALLOUT.DOWNGRADEFALLOUT WHERE BATCHID = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SubscriberId} = toString(SubscriberId),
		{Copy of AnticipatedDowngradeDate} = toString(AnticipatedDowngradeDate),
		{Copy of SubscriberName} = toString(SubscriberName),
		{Copy of ClassId} = toString(ClassId),
		{Copy of EX19DTE} = toString(EX19DTE),
		{Copy of CovType} = toString(CovType),
		{Copy of GroupId} = toString(GroupId),
		{Copy of PremDueDte} = toString(PremDueDte),
		{Copy of DowngradeFallOutReason} = DowngradeFallOutReason,
		{Copy of PremDue} = toString(PremDue),
		{Copy of BatchId} = toLong(BatchId)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of SubscriberId} as string,
		{Copy of PremDue} as string,
		{Copy of CovType} as string,
		{Copy of BatchId} as long,
		{Copy of DowngradeFallOutReason} as string,
		{Copy of SubscriberName} as string,
		{Copy of PremDueDte} as string,
		{Copy of AnticipatedDowngradeDate} as string,
		{Copy of ClassId} as string,
		{Copy of GroupId} as string,
		{Copy of EX19DTE} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
